hypotheses.claim: Original disconnected hyperpolarization exceeds the registered physical domain, even for the native/formula teacher.
hypotheses.test: Calibrate negative current using native teacher only. Freeze common fixed-current settings across geometry/coupling before inspecting candidate outcomes. Suggested calibration targets -90/-110/-130mV are stimulus difficulty targets, NOT relaxed acceptance thresholds.
hypotheses.discriminator: Original nine out-of-domain checks remain reported; calibrated reference stays within original physical bounds and native numerical floors.

hypotheses.claim: The41r learned Nap_h rate readout regressed outside the opened repair coverage; equilibrium alone is not the primary error at the probed voltage.
hypotheses.test: Paired learned-head rollback factorial: keep41r everywhere, restore only Nap_h update-logit head, only equilibrium-logit head (negative causal control), or both from the verified pre41r learned baseline. No analytic runtime replacement in selectable candidates.
hypotheses.discriminator: Rate-only rollback rescues state/current response while equilibrium-only rollback does not; test old41r pass cases to expose reintroduced regressions.

hypotheses.claim: Ih transient error reflects an existing learned rate bias, not a new41r change or necessarily missing memory.
hypotheses.test: Frozen coefficient probes and factorial oracle controls for x_inf versus update probability on common voltage paths; constrained Ih kinetic readouts (inf and rate) as a learned sidecar only after FIT/DEV freeze.
hypotheses.discriminator: At -106mV/seed29 the100ms gate error is .01271; canonical-rate-only diagnostic reduces it to .0000287, equilibrium-only does not.

hypotheses.claim: Negative-tail coverage, optimization budget or frozen-feature conditioning may limit a constrained rate-head repair.
hypotheses.test: Equal-count nominal vs tail-balanced FIT support crossed with B vs4B updates, using paired initialization/minibatch indices and checkpoints from the same two training trajectories per seed. Same objective across arms. Diagnostic least-squares projection onto the same frozen readout features bounds optimization error.
hypotheses.discriminator: Coverage effect at fixed budget versus budget effect at fixed coverage. Least-squares success with SGD failure points to optimization; failure of both does not justify assuming more compute suffices.

hypotheses.claim: Flat Ih onset/offset crossings can turn small current bias into large registered timing error.
hypotheses.test: Measure current residual and reference slope at the unchanged10%-transient crossings; compare predicted shift deltaI/slope to measured shift. Also save pulse-local event identities as diagnostic sidecar.
hypotheses.discriminator: Concentration at flat crossings supports sensitivity of the observable; registered global timing failures still count. No event-window retuning or threshold waiver.

hypotheses.claim: FP32 recurrence roundoff is the main source of the observed large Nap_h discrepancy.
hypotheses.test: Same frozen FP32 coefficients, FP32 versus FP64 recurrence and exact constant-voltage solution; a small saved-path precision control, not a new selectable precision policy.
hypotheses.discriminator: Current constant-clamp probe maximum roundoff .0000722, versus Nap_h learned-coefficient error .0761 at -106mV; therefore roundoff alone is not supported as the dominant explanation there.

phases.name: A native calibration
phases.detail: Teacher-only calibration and freeze. One fixed-current panel preserves coupling counterfactuals; do not independently retune each geometry and call that a pure coupling effect.

phases.name: B atomic identification
phases.detail: Common V clamps and replay of saved45 V/Ca paths; x_inf/rate2x2 oracle diagnostics per gate, initial-state and100/500/1000ms probes; teacher-reset one-step versus free gate recurrence. Oracles are never selectable.

phases.name: C constrained learned repair
phases.detail: Proposed small FIT/DEV-only support×budget matrix on the relevant rate readouts, plus fixed-feature least-squares diagnostic. Numeric budgets, split hashes and candidate nomination rule must be preregistered before execution.

phases.name: D paired coupled confirmation of mechanism
phases.detail: Small2x2x2 factorial: Nap_h learned-rate rollback on/off, pre-frozen Ih inf-readout repair on/off, Ih rate-readout repair on/off. Eight contrasts include unchanged41r. Keep original current algebra/Ca/axial solver and18 states. Compare imposed/autonomous and0/.25/1 coupling with identical streams. Final case/budget caps must be preregistered; no indiscriminate extra arms.

regression_guards: Keep all72 interpretable original45 cases unchanged as opened regression fixtures; safe calibration must not erase the difficult -106mV examples.
Retain original nine out-of-domain cases as labelled diagnostics, never reclassify them as model passes.
Use43/44 regressions and original41r previously-passing stress cases; original six41 failures remain explicit accepted limitations, not retroactively promoted.
Same original current/gate/charge/timing/physical/native-floor thresholds. No aggregate cancellation of prefix or qualitative failures.
Record hidden gate states as well as currents/V; small voltage error does not excuse wrong Nap_h memory.
No analytic oracle in a nominated network; no abstraction reduction. Keep41r checkpoint immutable.
No independent47 data access or automatic release/promotion. This is a proposal, not an executed45b.
